items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Dick' multiple times (e.g., 'What paid for all that, Dick...', 'Well, they'd just make you blow your heart out, Dick...'). There is no mention of a person named Dick Allen in the transcript.

ctx.x: A dollar and a couple. Nine to six, that's six o'clock at night?

All day, all day. From nine to morning, six at night. What paid for all that, Dick, they used to put out an ad card and then take it around to the business people and get a five or ten dollar ad. Well, before they threw the picnic, everything was paid for. The band, the eats, the liquor, whatever they had was paid for. And what would they do with these cards? Well, they'd just put them around town as advertisements, see.
